worker_target_description: Post-exclusion average-person condition: paired comparison of participants’ own heart-attack likelihood with estimated likelihood for an average person. Table 8 identifies the condition N; Table 11 identifies the paired test and heart-attack Likelihood outcome.
worker_notes: Identity assessment: title Revisiting Illusion of Invulnerability effect: Replication and extension of Perloff and Fetzer (1986), authors Lyu (Elaine) Hongye and Gilad Feldman, and explicit Year: 2020 / Stage of submission: Final report identify this as the primary replication report matching the supplied reference (Hongye is presented as a given name in the report). The document cites the original DOI 10.1037/0022-3514.50.3.502, states that the replication combines original Studies 1 and 2, and includes methods and final results. No replication DOI is supplied. Only n_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target selected by heart-attack likelihood, self-versus-average-person comparison, and condition labels, not row order or numeric matching. Locator discrepancy: supplied Table 10 reports between-condition ANOVAs; the described within-person average-person comparison is Table 11. Table 8 explicitly prints average-person n = 147 and Exclusion explicitly states subsequent reported analyses use post-exclusion N = 584. No N sum or df derivation was used. Table 11 prints a t(249) header, inconsistent with the condition count; that header was not used to infer N. No PDF was supplied, so layout could not be rendered.
